FX-DIRBLUR-001.says: Direction 0, length 4: every edge streaks up and down, two pixels each way, the second faint, and left and right stay sharp.

FX-DIRBLUR-002.says: Direction 90, length 4: the same streak left and right, and up and down stay sharp.

FX-DIRBLUR-003.says: Direction 270, the opposite way: the streak runs both ways, so this is FX-DIRBLUR-002.

FX-DIRBLUR-004.says: Direction 45, length 6: a diagonal streak, up and right and down and left, between pixels.

FX-DIRBLUR-006.says: Length 1, direction 90: each column mixes itself and the two beside it at a twelfth, five sixths and a twelfth, so the block's left edge column is eleven twelfths covered and the column outside it one twelfth.

FX-DIRBLUR-007.says: Length 2.5, direction 90: a length that is not a whole number, the streak fading to its ends.

FX-DIRBLUR-008.says: Direction 3600, ten turns: this is FX-DIRBLUR-001.

FX-DIRBLUR-009.says: Direction 90, length 6, moved three pixels right: the line on the drawing's left edge streaks three pixels past it into the grown border.

FX-DIRBLUR-010.says: Length keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4, direction 90, linear: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 at length 4 is FX-DIRBLUR-002, frame 4 at 8.

FX-DIRBLUR-011.says: Direction keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 90 at frame 4, length 4: frame 0 is FX-DIRBLUR-001, frame 2 streaks at 45 degrees, frame 4 is FX-DIRBLUR-002.

FX-DIRBLUR-012.says: Length 501, above 500. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIRBLUR-013.says: Length -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIRBLUR-014.says: Direction 3601, past ten turns. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIRBLUR-015.says: Length keyed to 600 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIRBLUR-016.says: Taper Ends off, FX-DIRBLUR-001 with D-98's flat average. Direction 0, length 4: every edge streaks up and down, two pixels each way and faintly a third, and left and right stay sharp.

FX-DIRBLUR-017.says: Taper Ends off, FX-DIRBLUR-002 with D-98's flat average. Direction 90, length 4: the same streak left and right, and up and down stay sharp.

FX-DIRBLUR-018.says: Taper Ends off, FX-DIRBLUR-003 with D-98's flat average. Direction 270, the opposite way: the streak runs both ways, so this is FX-DIRBLUR-017.

FX-DIRBLUR-019.says: Taper Ends off, FX-DIRBLUR-004 with D-98's flat average. Direction 45, length 6: a diagonal streak, up and right and down and left, between pixels.

FX-DIRBLUR-020.says: Taper Ends off, FX-DIRBLUR-005 with D-98's flat average. Length 0: the drawing, untouched.

FX-DIRBLUR-021.says: Taper Ends off, FX-DIRBLUR-006 with D-98's flat average. Length 1, direction 90: each column mixes itself and the two beside it at a quarter, a half and a quarter, so the block's left edge column is three quarters covered and the column outside it one quarter.

FX-DIRBLUR-022.says: Taper Ends off, FX-DIRBLUR-007 with D-98's flat average. Length 2.5, direction 90: a length that is not a whole number, the ends of the average softened.

FX-DIRBLUR-023.says: Taper Ends off, FX-DIRBLUR-008 with D-98's flat average. Direction 3600, ten turns: this is FX-DIRBLUR-016.

FX-DIRBLUR-024.says: Taper Ends off, FX-DIRBLUR-009 with D-98's flat average. Direction 90, length 6, moved three pixels right: the line on the drawing's left edge streaks three pixels past it into the grown border.

FX-DIRBLUR-025.says: Taper Ends off, FX-DIRBLUR-010 with D-98's flat average. Length keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4, direction 90, linear: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 at length 4 is FX-DIRBLUR-017, frame 4 at 8.

FX-DIRBLUR-026.says: Taper Ends off, FX-DIRBLUR-011 with D-98's flat average. Direction keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 90 at frame 4, length 4: frame 0 is FX-DIRBLUR-016, frame 2 streaks at 45 degrees, frame 4 is FX-DIRBLUR-017.

FX-DIRBLUR-027.says: Taper Ends "on" written in the file: FX-DIRBLUR-001 exactly, as a file without the word.

FX-DIRBLUR-028.says: Taper Ends written "Off", the panel's name, not the word "off". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIRBLUR-029.says: Taper Ends written "yes". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
